text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whew, today was so fun too... Let's go 
together again, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whew, today was so fun too... Let's go 
together again, Big Sister.

On our way back from going out together, 
Rice Shower suddenly came to a halt...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wooww...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, you see, I was just thinking the 
sunset is so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight reflecting off the river 
makes you feel like a gentle warmth is 
wafting all around...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... This scenery kind of makes me want 
to draw it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Whenever I see a beautiful view, I 
just want to capture that feeling 
forever...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If we want to preserve the view, a photo 
would probably be better, though.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because a drawing preserves... the 
feelings Rice felt at that moment, too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Dear brother, please head back to 
the academy first. I'm sure I'd only bore 
you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Dear sister, please head back to the 
academy first. I'm sure I'd only bore 
you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh... But... It'll take too much time...
choice_data_list: I want to see Rice Shower's drawing.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! In that case, Rice will draw 
her very best...!

Afterward, Rice Shower showed me the 
picture she drew. It was a sunset painted 
in gentle colors that somehow filled the 
heart with happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: How... is it...?
choice_data_list: It makes you feel so happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! What a relief... Rice's 
feelings really reached you...
choice_data_list: I want to see a little more

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R... Really!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then... would it be okay if I show you 
my drawings from time to time...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you praise my drawings, Big 
Brother, it just... makes me feel all warm 
inside...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When Big Sister praises my drawings, it 
just... makes me feel so warm inside...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Brother...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You too, Big Brother...?!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You too, Big Sister...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-Then... Rice will lend you her pen...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
As for sketchbooks... Oh no, there's only 
one...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Right, there's a stationery store nearby, 
so I'll go buy some. Please wait for me, 
Dear Brother...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Right, there's a stationery store nearby, 
so I'll go buy some. Please wait for me, 
Dear Sister...!"

Rice Shower eagerly went to buy a 
sketchbook with a very happy look on her 
face.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah…… I usually draw by myself, so I 
didn't know, but……

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Drawing together with someone is so much 
fun...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Or... is it because I'm with you, Big 
Brother? Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Or... is it because I'm with you, Big 
Sister? Fufu."

Afterward, using the sketchbook Rice 
Shower had bought, we drew the sunset 
together.
